cases.name: ARM NEON rejected at baseline
cases.reason: LLVM 22.1.8 handling of ARMv7 NEON with an unspecified feature mask varies between build contexts. Native and WASM may both accept it, while earlier matching builds rejected it natively and accepted it in WASM. Explicit -neon,-mve and +neon agree.

expected_signatures.description: Native and WASM both accept despite the baseline policy
